tools.name: Claude Code Auto Mode
tools.detail: default on Pro, Max and Team since August 14; still stops for irreversible, destructive or out-of-environment actions

claims: Users approve 97% of permission prompts Claude Code shows
Measured by Anthropic across 1,053 paid users
Human review caught 13.6% of harmful actions in the same test; auto mode caught 89%
Auto mode became the default on Pro, Max and Team on August 14
It still stops for anything irreversible, destructive or pointed outside your environment
Creator stopped rubber-stamping prompts he wasn't reading
how_to_steps: Leave auto mode on (it is now the default) instead of approving every prompt
Rely on its hard stops for destructive/irreversible/external actions
Follow a plan -> build -> review workflow rather than per-action approval (creator's lesson is linked in bio)
